why: These files were imported from a Word document and contain identifiable patient data. This site has NO authentication, so uploading them publishes that data to anyone who can reach the URL. Replace each file with a screenshot taken in a training/PLAY environment using fictional patients, then delete its entry from this list. `npm run manifest` warns while any listed file is still the original.
